name: What if I have no plans or documentation for my older kitchen?

mainEntity.name: What if I have no plans or documentation for my older kitchen?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can begin without complete architectural drawings, but a reliable redesign still needs verified measurements and information about utilities and the surrounding structure. Photos, appliance model numbers, cabinet dimensions, and prior plans are useful; unknown conditions should be identified rather than assumed. If you do not have documentation, tell the design-build team early so site verification can be planned. Avoid ordering cabinets from an unverified sketch. Elite Remodeling & Design’s process includes design development and coordination with construction requirements, which is useful when existing information is incomplete.
acceptedAnswer.description: Start with photos and basic measurements, but expect the existing space to be verified before final design or cabinet ordering. Tell the team which utility and structural details are unknown. A site review can identify conditions that old or missing plans do not show.
